name: Requirement Provenance
rule: Every code/change task cites authoritative requirement IDs and source phase.

name: No Silent Assumptions
rule: Missing business rules/formulas/permissions become governed gaps.

name: Test With Implementation
rule: Mapped automated/manual acceptance evidence accompanies implementation.

name: Tenant Isolation
rule: All SaaS data, config, entitlements and branding remain tenant scoped.

name: API Contract Discipline
rule: Approved API/event schemas are versioned compatibility boundaries.
enforcement: Breaking changes require new version/change approval.

name: Data Migration Discipline
rule: Schema/data changes include migration, reconciliation and rollback.

name: AI Governance
rule: AI models/prompts/tools require versioning, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring and human policy.

name: Observability
rule: Production features emit governed logs/metrics/traces and audit events.

name: Security by Default
rule: Least privilege, secrets management, encryption and vulnerability gates apply.

name: Feature Flags
rule: Incomplete/high-risk releases use governed feature flags when appropriate.

name: Rollback Ready
rule: Every production-impacting release has verified rollback/recovery behavior.

name: Traceability Update
rule: Accepted changes update requirement-test-code-release traceability.

name: Human Approval Boundaries
rule: AI cannot approve legal, financial, security, safety, contractual or enterprise-lock decisions.

name: Canonical Libraries
rule: Shared services/materials/resources/rates/assemblies use governed master-library identifiers.

name: Audit Immutability
rule: Approval, release, pricing, commercial and security audit records preserve history.

name: Environment Promotion
rule: Artifacts/configuration promote through approved environments; no ad hoc production mutation.

name: White Label Governance
rule: Branding/customization is configuration-driven and cannot fork core business logic silently.

name: Performance Acceptance
rule: Critical workflows meet approved latency/throughput/capacity targets.

name: Accessibility Acceptance
rule: User-facing surfaces meet approved accessibility criteria.

name: DR Acceptance
rule: Backup/restore and RTO/RPO recovery evidence exists for critical services.

name: Commercial Calculation Controls
rule: Estimate/job cost/change/claim/payment calculations retain formula/version/source provenance.

name: Construction AI Evidence
rule: Plan/spec/takeoff AI outputs retain source-page/location/confidence/review evidence.

name: Change Control
rule: Post-lock changes require change request, impact analysis, approvals, version update and regression scope.

name: Definition of Done
rule: Requirement implemented, tested, documented, observable, secure, traceable, accepted and releasable.
